peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 8.2% below its local comparables; 13 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (84.3): 6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 43 of 51 similar developments. Context, not scored: resales in 83.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Redhill MRT about 540 m, Tiong Bahru MRT about 1,080 m; closer than 5 of 51 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Alexandra Primary School about 480 m; more than 9 of 51 similar developments (the same as 14). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 720 m), more than 15 of 51 similar developments (the same as 5); nearest hawker centre Redhill Market about 630 m; nearest park Tiong Bahru Park about 490 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Upperhouse at Orchard Boulevard, 47 new sales, about 1,060 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 1,200 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 1,310 m; Penrith, 457 new sales, about 1,350 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 1,410 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 1,420 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 1,490 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 1,590 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 211 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,716 new sales and 1,001 resales (2,717 purchases); new sales were 63.2% of these purchases. Subsales (11) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,001 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 50 of 51 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,001 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,167 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−14.2%). Planning-area private resales −18%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
